blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Southern Leyte is seeking to revive regular commercial flights at the Maasin City Airport, with a possible direct route to Clark being explored as the province pushes to improve air connectivity and support tourism and economic activity. Gov. Damian Mercado discussed the proposed Maasin-Clark route with Sunlight Air Chief Operating Officer Edgardo Diaz during a meeting in Manila on Sept. 11. The proposed route could provide Southern Leyte residents with a more direct air link to Central Luzon, reducing the need for travelers bound for Manila and other destinations to first travel by land to Tacloban City to […]...
